benchmark.name: VerilogEval v2 — Spec-to-RTL

summary.en: VerilogEval v2 measures whether models can translate digital-hardware specifications into functionally correct SystemVerilog RTL modules.
summary.zh: VerilogEval v2 测试模型能否把数字电路自然语言规格转换成功能正确的 SystemVerilog RTL 模块。

task_format.en: The model receives a natural-language hardware specification and port interface, then generates one complete SystemVerilog TopModule.
task_format.zh: 模型会收到自然语言硬件规格和端口接口，再生成一个完整的 SystemVerilog TopModule。

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of 156 corrected v2 tasks whose single zero-shot RTL response compiles and passes Icarus Verilog functional simulation.
explanation.zh: 分数是 156 个修订后 v2 task 中，单次 zero-shot RTL 回答能够编译并通过 Icarus Verilog 功能仿真的比例。

observations.evaluation_protocol: VerilogEval v2 corrected 156-task human set, Specification-to-RTL, zero-shot, temperature 0, top-p 0.01, n=1, official extraction and Icarus Verilog v12 simulation. Completion, one-shot, stochastic, v1, and MachineEval rows are excluded.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
